model.title: Protecting Domestic Mining Act of 2025
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Jefferson Shreve (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would streamline federal environmental reviews for mining infrastructure projects by making them permanently eligible for expedited approval under existing transportation law. It would also block a separate government rule that would have narrowed expedited reviews to only critical minerals mining, preserving broader eligibility for various types of mining projects.
